# Mettākathā (Ps 2.4)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Mettākathā* ("Discussion of Love") is the fourth chapter of the second division (Yuganaddhavagga) of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* in the Khuddaka Nikāya. The text presents an extensive and systematic treatment of loving-kindness (*mettā*), opening with a quotation of the *Mettānisaṁsa* discourse found in the Aṅguttara Nikāya, which enumerates the eleven advantages of cultivating love [Sarada Thero]. It provides a detailed exposition of methods for suffusing beings with loving-kindness arranged in numerical order, combining these techniques with the factors of awakening (*bodhipakkhiyā dhammā*), namely the five faculties (*indriya*), the five powers (*bala*), the seven awakening factors (*bojjhaṅga*), and the noble eightfold path [Sarada Thero].
